findings: Stage A baseline passed before B/C. Latest sheng main only changes Novatek pin/records; WiFi/BT/thermal/display production files in that delta are identical. No nonexistent upstream reconnect fix is claimed and no Novatek update is imported.

New Adreno kernel/runtime source ABI and pacing/recovery fixes are pinned locally. All upstream GPU translation units and shared headers plus archive SHA qualify reuse; old archives rebuild. Runtime uses a sealed source stamp and prefers the matching completed kernel-step addon/trust pair, retaining Mesa/Rust caches.

Journal uses16MiB per slot,33566720 total bytes,4s regular pause and bounded300ms urgent API. Portable decoder accepts valid4/16MiB geometry. Urgent requests reuse the one validated writer; a timeout is reported and cannot guarantee persistence before an instantaneous fault.

CPU70/80/90C andGPU68/78/88C pressure policies plus30s CPU TOP5. Actual kernproc lives in allproc and binds kernel_task; task_info returns recount times. Iterator callback IAe4fe matches the existing native core at all four call sites. Existing16ms CPU load governor is not replaced by a guessed frequency cap.

Default USB debug masks0, explicitusb-debug=1 retains prior masks. Empty-bus IRQ bridge backs off20ms. DP4lane disables onlySS root port with xHCI neutral/RW1C semantics, switchesUTMI, and retainsUSB2 XHCI/nub/rings. Hub errors capture bounded slot1/2,EP0,SetupTRB and event data.

Pinned Linux dwc3 core enables park/split options only through explicit quirks, absent from the actual Samsung node. No speculative park/split register change is made; downstream CC6 STALL root cause remains unknown pending the added probes.

WiFi pending DISCONNECT is not queued a second time. Board/ifnet/vdev MAC values are now compared at creation; truncated physical log lacks surviving bind evidence, so a mismatch is not asserted. Atomic64-line owner/dispatch/error/duration probes expose the next failed join.

DP checks QMP resets/AUX branches and retained GCC domains before DISPCC/controller/DPU access, enables verified DISP AHB/XO/AHB branches, and emits twelve bounded urgent breadcrumbs. Dedicated external DP PHY/clock/DPU/display sources are unchanged.

Internal logical2640x1080 is rotated by the production GPU AIR kernel into unchanged1080x2640 GOP; early CPU fallback and touch use inverse transforms. Actual AIR host execution validates0/90/270 andhalf-color output; full-size padded-row CPU bounds and touch corners/center pass ASan/UBSan.

HiDPI uses chosen display-scale2, native timing,156x64mm EDID and the standard big-endian scale-resolutions CFData mode. Actual27.3 CoreDisplay/SkyLight consumer disassembly is retained in reference/display-xrefs.json. InventedIOFBHiDPI/IOMFBLogicalWidth properties are absent. Real1320x540@2x backing and settings UI await hardware.

Touch protocol/worker/click behavior is byte-identical outside publish coordinate mapping; Bluetooth whole executor/FIFO, WCN power, TI3e, UEFI/DMA/HAL, Apple inputs, workflow andboard arguments retain their protected hashes.
